_seller_summary: Seller bot v1 (2026-05-17). Sells Iron Condors on RANGE-classified days only. Defined-risk only — no naked sells. Force-close 15:15 IST. Paper mode only for first 2 weeks of observation.
_seller_mode_help: When true, main.py runs the iron-condor entry/monitor/close loop instead of the buyer scan. Reuses the regime classifier via the dispatcher.

seller_strategy._strategy_help: Iron Condor: SHORT OTM CE, LONG further-OTM CE, SHORT OTM PE, LONG further-OTM PE. Defined risk on both sides.
seller_strategy._strikes_help: On NIFTY (step 50): short legs are ATM +/- 200 pts (4 strikes OTM). Long legs are short +/- 100 pts (2 strikes further OTM). Tighten for low-IV days; widen for high-IV.
seller_strategy._credit_help: Reject the entry if combined premium collected < this. Ensures decent reward-to-risk.
seller_strategy._exit_help: Close at 50% of max profit (50% of net credit). Stop loss at 1.5x the credit received (e.g. Rs.30 credit -> SL at -Rs.45 combined). Force close 15:15 IST.
seller_strategy._window_help: Skip opening hour (volatile) and last 2 hours (theta decays too fast for fresh entries). Sweet spot 10:30-13:30.

seller_entry_gates._regime_help: Only enter when classifier verdict is RANGE. CHOP also acceptable; TREND/EXPIRY skipped.
seller_entry_gates._vix_gate_help: VIX gate DISABLED for v1 (set to 999 = effectively off). 2026-05-17 sweep showed that no threshold ≥13 actually filters the worst loss day, and the conservative (≤12) setting throws out too many wins. Trading all days to capture maximum learning signal in paper mode. To re-enable: set this to 14 (moderate, 97% win rate) or 12 (conservative, 100% win rate in 213-day sample).
seller_entry_gates._iv_help: Skip if ATM IV percentile (vs last 30 days) < threshold. Selling cheap premium = no edge. NOT YET IMPLEMENTED in v1 (needs 30 days of macro history first).
seller_entry_gates._or_help: Spot must have stayed inside Opening Range for the last 60 min (range confirmation per playbook). NOT YET IMPLEMENTED in v1.

risk._risk_help: v1 is intentionally conservative. One position at a time, one lot per position. Scale up after 2 weeks of clean paper results.
